d:
A massive, bipedal Pokémon with hyper-evolved armor plating. The body is a metallic silver shade with an abundance of deep crimson armor shards protruding from the shoulders, back, and head. Its head is broader with a single, small, pale yellow eye on each side and larger, jagged horn-like protrusions. It has massive, armored arms with three claws on each hand. No tail.
BODY COLOR: metallic silver
